mapper.select: SELECT , a.content FROM assets a LEFT JOIN asset_tags link ON link.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{assetId} ORDER BY link.tag_id
SELECT type FROM assets WHERE id = #{assetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (id, type, name, description, content, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{name}, #{description}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM asset_tags WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE theme = #{assetId})
SELECT s.id FROM assets a JOIN projects p ON p.theme = a.id JOIN sessions s ON s.project_id = p.id WHERE a.id = #{themeId} AND a.content != #{content}
